title: Zesty Smoked Irish Grana-Padano Bake
description: A charred and savory dish featuring the pungent flavors of Grana-Padano, slow-cooked to perfection. Served in a bamboo steamer for a unique and satisfying experience.
instructions: Combine Grana-Padano, smoked salmon, garlic, and thyme in a mixing bowl.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the mixture to the bamboo steamer, and cover with a lid.
Steam for 20 minutes, or until the Grana-Padano is melted and the salmon is cooked through.
Remove the steamer from the heat, and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Zesty Smoked Irish Grana-Padano Bake hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the microwave or oven before serving.
